justification: Campbelltown Part 3 went live; one rule (253624, 3.8.2 b) could not be page-proven because the PDF prints a hidden duplicate of every line and the rule runs from page 67 onto 68; DQ-145 went to 108 over the 107 ceiling. page_texts gains a de-doubled clean reading; a page_break fallback proves a rule whose exact words run unbroken across a page break. Applied live, verifier 1/1, DQ-145 107, outreach 21/21.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_page_evidence_fallback.py tests/test_page_evidence.py tests/test_page_proof_gate_dq101.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a doubled line is not provable, a rule across a page break is not proven, a changed word or non-adjacent pages are proven, or the verifier accepts a moved split
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Disabling the clean reading, the page-break search, the page-break fallback or the verifier's half check each failed a test; restored, all pass.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/page_evidence.py: live plan for 253624 verified 1/1 against the pinned PDF with --db

pre_impl.existing_data: row 253624: words 0-80 unbroken on clean page 67, 81-135 on clean page 68; raw fitz text holds the hidden duplicate
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: the proof tools read the raw text layer, which still carries the doubled copy after the reader fix
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends page_evidence and its verifier; same applier

functions.name: page_break_hits
functions.input: rule words and the PDF pages
functions.output: every page where the rule's words run unbroken to the next page, with the split point and offsets
functions.if_none: empty list, and the row stays unproven

values.read_at: each half must be a real run of words, not a stray phrase

break_it.scenario: one word changed on the second page
break_it.what_happens: the rule is not proven by the page-break proof

break_it.scenario: the two halves sit on pages that are not next to each other
a recorded split is moved in the evidence file
break_it.what_happens: the verifier rejects the evidence and nothing is written

break_it.scenario: a PDF prints a hidden copy of every line
break_it.what_happens: the clean reading proves the line once

mutation_analysis: Changing <= to < in the ratchet fails test_at_ceiling_passes. Removing the ratchet from CLAIMS fails test_oc20_is_wired_with_all_three_parts.
residual_risk: The badge inventory checks each file, not each citation expression: a component with one badge and a second bare citation passes (Sol, 2026-10-17). Hard-wired checked={false} cards always show the mark. The ceiling must be lowered by hand after each proof pass.

post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/dq_check.py --outreach on main prints 21 of 21
